audit_event.notes: Per design.md §EH.3, E_REVOKED is one of the four errors that MUST be pushed into HP's view channel (critical bucket). Per Requirement 9.4.1, the iFay must immediately stop D-dimension actions on receipt of REVOKE-NOTIFY.
audit_event.reason: E_REVOKED — call presented an already-Revoked Mandate

notes: Couples Requirement 4.3 (irreversibility) with §EH.3 (audit and HP view channel routing for E_REVOKED). The error claims field carries `mandate_id` so auditors can reconstruct the five-tuple (error_code, mandate_id, ts, rp_id, reason).

signature_verification.note: REVOKE envelope is signed by HP (Requirement 4.1.3 — REVOKE auth-strength ≥ BOOTSTRAP auth-strength). REVOKE_RECEIPT / ERROR is signed by MS. Both envelopes use canonical CBOR as signing input regardless of wire encoding.

summary: Use-after-revoke: presenting a Revoked Mandate yields an ERROR response with code=1006 / name=E_REVOKED. The ERROR is pushed to HP's view channel in the critical bucket (§EH.3). Validates Requirement 9.4.1.
